_comment: What each villager thinks of gifts. Tiers: love, like, neutral, dislike. An item that is not listed for a villager is 'neutral'. Item ids are the ones in items.json. Each list goes from favourite to least favourite. 'lines' = what a villager says for ONE gift (use {player} for the player's name). If a gift has no line of its own, the villager says one 'npc_reactions' line for the tier, and if there is none, one of the general 'reactions' for the tier ({item} = the gift's name).
